mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, board_data.* FROM ( SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.guest_author_no, b.category, b.answer_status, b.title, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, g.guest_name AS guest_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_no = b.no ) AS answer_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no LEFT JOIN guest_author g ON b.guest_author_no = g.no WHERE (#{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR b.category = #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND ( #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(b.no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR b.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR g.guest_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' ) ORDER BY b.no DESC ) board_data WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no LEFT JOIN guest_author g ON b.guest_author_no = g.no WHERE (#{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR b.category = #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND ( #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(b.no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR b.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR g.guest_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' )

SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.guest_author_no, b.category, b.answer_status, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, g.guest_name AS guest_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_no = b.no ) AS answer_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no LEFT JOIN guest_author g ON b.guest_author_no = g.no WHERE b.no = #{boardNo}
